ignoredPolicyNote: Fingerprint includes tracked + untracked + deleted files, plus ignored files EXCEPT: .treeverdict/receipts (own receipts), .git, node_modules, and standard cache/build outputs (dist, build, coverage, .next, etc. — see policy exclude list). All other ignored files (e.g. .env, *.local.js) ARE hashed: an ignored file that code loads is still code. To exclude anything else, add it to `exclude` explicitly; that changes the policy hash and STALEs old receipts.
